newsitem.title: SPAIN: Lisbon air cargo traffic rises 9.1 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon air cargo traffic rises 9.1 pct in March.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport rose 9.1 percent in March to 9,156 tonnes, the Portuguese airports authority ANA said. This takes the total in the first three months of the year to 25,407 tonnes, a 12.6 percent increase on the same period 1996.
Passenger numbers at Lisbon were also 9.1 percent higher than the same month a year earlier at 526,951.
The number of aircraft movements rose 1.3 percent in the month to 6,241.

Cargo business at Porto, the country's second biggest air freight airport, was up 23.2 percent in March at 2,591 tonnes, putting its accumulated total at 7,677 tonnes, 28.8 percent ahead of last year. Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
